description: Add files to an open begin_deploy session; call it as often as needed, then commit_deploy publishes them together. Paths, extensions and encodings are checked on every call. A 100-250 KB text file usually fits in one call with encoding:'gzip+base64' (gzip locally, then base64); prefer that over add_file_chunk. If your shell can reach mcp.vibedeploy.be, one tar(.gz) POST to begin_deploy's uploadUrl is faster still.

anyOf.description: Array form; needed for binary files.

content.description: File content: text, or base64 as set by encoding.

encoding.description: utf8 (default), base64 (binary files), or gzip+base64 (gzip locally, then base64; fits 3-5x more text per call).

path.description: Path relative to the site root, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js. Plain ASCII, no leading slash.

anyOf.description: Map form: path to UTF-8 text.

files.description: Files to stage, same shape as in deploy_site. Re-adding a path overwrites the staged version. 500 MB per session in total.

name: add_files

remainingBudget.description: Bytes still available before hitting the 500 MB cap.

totalBytes.description: Total bytes staged so far across all add_files calls.

totalFiles.description: Total files now in the scratch dir.

title: Add files to a staging session
